reproResult: Core bug REPRODUCED in my own worktree/instance at 16ceb3a54 (App :12702, Server :20702). Unit repros A and B: both fail on main exactly as printed in the report (unrecognized_keys fileOpenerOwner; toast called once, updateThreadTabs zero times), and pass after applying repro/proposed-fix.diff; full turbo build with the fix regenerates the plugin-sdk bundled types as claimed. Live path C (bb thread open README.md): 'Couldn't sync tabs' toast with the zod JSON appeared and no PUT was sent (only GETs), BUT contrary to the report the README Docs tab DID appear in the strip (~2.8 s later) and it also survived a reload, because a fresh thread's server tab list is at revision 0 and the app takes the localStorage-migration path instead of reconciling. Live path D (Diff-panel click) after resetting the server list to revision 1: reproduced exactly (Docs editor opens, toast, no PUT, tab gone after reload; server row unchanged). Two practical hiccups: the author's dev-browser scripts exceed the default 30 s script timeout (need --timeout), and they hard-code the author's ports/project/thread ids. Artifacts saved under /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1773/verify/.

findings.section: Claims vs findings / TL;DR / Related issues
findings.problem: The report states #1708 'shipped in desktop 0.38.0' and cites `git tag --contains 564090dfb → desktop-v0.38.0` as evidence for a Verified claim. That is false: tag/release desktop-v0.38.0 points at 45145e51a (published 2026-08-15) while #1708 (564090dfb) merged 2026-08-17; `git merge-base --is-ancestor 564090dfb desktop-v0.38.0` is false and the tag's tree contains no fileOpenerOwner. The reporter is on a dev/nightly build whose version string is still 0.38.0.
findings.evidence: git log -1 desktop-v0.38.0 → 45145e51a 'Prepare bb-app 0.38.0' (2026-08-14); gh release view desktop-v0.38.0 → publishedAt 2026-08-15, target 45145e51a; gh pr view 1708 → mergedAt 2026-08-17T22:36Z; git grep -c fileOpenerOwner desktop-v0.38.0 -- apps/app/src → no matches.
findings.fix: Replace the claim with: #1708 merged 2026-08-17 after the 0.38.0 release; the reporter's '0.38.0' is a post-release main/nightly build (packages/bb-app version is still 0.38.0 at 16ceb3a54). Remove the fabricated git tag --contains output from the appendix.

findings.section: Minimal reproduction C and D (expected vs actual)
findings.problem: The report asserts that via `bb thread open` the opener tab 'never even appears' (reconciled away in the same render pass) and that after reload the tab is gone. Following the steps literally on a fresh thread, the tab does appear and survives reload: the server list is at revision 0, so useFixedPanelTabsState takes the localStorage-migration branch (fixed-panel-tabs.ts:224) and never reconciles. The 'lost on reload' outcome requires the server row to already have revision > 0, which the author only achieved with an out-of-band PUT reset mentioned in the appendix, not in the numbered steps. The 'never appears' branch is a timing race presented as deterministic.
findings.evidence: verify/watch-C-output.txt: TIMELINE 2803ms strip=["Close README.md"], TOAST present, only GETs; then reload → STRIP AFTER RELOAD: ["Close README.md"] with GET /tabs → {"revision":0,"tabs":[]}. After curl PUT to revision 1, path D reproduced as reported (verify/diff-click-D-output.txt, STRIP AFTER RELOAD: []).
findings.fix: Add an explicit precondition step (open/close the Diff panel or otherwise persist tabs once so revision > 0, or state the PUT reset) before path C/D, and soften the path-C claim to 'the tab may be reconciled away immediately (race)'; note the revision-0 localStorage exception.

findings.problem: The dev-browser scripts hard-code the author's ports and ids (localhost:18477, proj_xmkmev8xtf, thr_vrsxemryh5, run-thread-open.sh cd's into the author's worktree) and exceed dev-browser's default 30 s script timeout, so a reader running `dev-browser ... run browser-reload-and-watch-fast.js` gets 'Script timed out after 30s' unless they add --timeout.
findings.evidence: First run: /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1773/verify/watch-C-output.txt (before --timeout 120) contained 'Script timed out after 30s and was terminated.'; scripts grep for localhost:18477.
findings.fix: State that the URLs/ids/worktree path in the scripts must be edited, and include the exact command with `--timeout 120`.

findings.problem: The report describes fileOpenerOwner as powering an 'Original toggle' the user can click; in code it is the diverted native preview passed to the opener as `experimental_Original` (PluginReplacementSlot) and the tab renders UnavailableFileOpenerTab when the field is missing. Both the author's and my browser logs show originalToggle=0 always, so the 'text=Original' probes in the scripts never fire.
findings.fix: Rephrase to 'the native preview handed to the opener as experimental_Original (fallback / unavailable state)' and drop the toggle language.
